findingDisposition.v6Speaker — carried forward unchanged as "present-tense consumer names sarif leftover-join.v7", which states the wrong target for the speaker sarif leftover-join.v8 and must move with the fourteen sites.
findings.subjectClaim: The dispatch pins "Speaker is sarif leftover-join.v8". The subject's artifact field, authorityClaim, purpose, doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone, proposedLaterWork and findingDisposition.speaker all speak in that voice. But in 9 of the 11 obligation rows and in 5 basedOn roles, the closing disclaimer sentence has sarif leftover-join.v7 — the frozen predecessor — as its grammatical subject.
findings.liveState: sarif leftover-join.v7 carries these sentences as correct first-person disclaimers, because v7 was the speaker when they were written. sarif leftover-join.v8 re-voices some of them and leaves fourteen unconverted. A diff of the two documents shows basedOn.g26v2.role, basedOn.g26v1.role, basedOn.occupancyG10V2.role, basedOn.contractV15.role, basedOn.d056.role and obligations[0], [1], [2], [3], [4], [6], [8], [9], [10] are byte-identical to v7 in these sentences, while obligations[5] OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX and obligations[7] OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX were rewritten and do close in the v8 voice.
findings.refutation:
This is not stylistic, and it is not cured by the sentences being true of v7's bytes. Four independent tests establish the defect.

(1) It is a reinstatement of an already-adjudicated finding class. sarif leftover-join.v6 was REJECTED for exactly this: Claude Stage A MF-1 read "Ten disclaimer sentences still speak as the frozen predecessor", and Codex returned an unlabeled SHOULD-FIX on the same class. D-325 records both. sarif leftover-join.v7's own authorityClaim states the repair shape in terms: "sarif leftover-join.v7 lands sarif leftover-join.v6 Stage A Claude MF-1 and Codex unlabeled SHOULD-FIX as one class: present-tense consumer in basedOn roles and obligation reasons names sarif leftover-join.v7." The landed rule is that the present-tense consumer names the SPEAKER. The speaker is now sarif leftover-join.v8, and fourteen sites still name v7. The subject re-opens the very finding its predecessor was recorded for closing.

(2) The subject's own converted rows prove the intended pattern and make the residue self-contradictory. OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX closes "sarif leftover-join.v8 does not remasure sarif-fc-nonauth-term-golden.v4, does not invent a D-002 platform list, and does not mint a D9 code"; OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX closes the same way. So basedOn.occupancyG10V2.role disclaims D-002 platform invention on behalf of v7 in the same document where OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX disclaims it on behalf of v8. basedOn.d056.role says "sarif leftover-join.v7 is not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle" while proposedLaterWork[4] says "sarif leftover-join.v8 is not that cycle." The document cannot be read as deliberately historical: none of the fourteen carries a historical marker, and the corpus writes genuine predecessor history with one — obligations[5] does exactly that, correctly, with "sarif leftover-join.v7 remasured leftover-design of those implementations stale as an authoring claim", which is why that sentence is not in this finding.

(3) The house norm is unambiguous and was measured, not assumed. The seven sibling joins named in the subject's own doesNot list were scanned for predecessor-voiced present-tense disclaimers: leftover-join.v7 of G29 has 0, leftover-join.v10 of G30 has 0, leftover-join.v20 of G21 has 0, leftover-join.v16 of G20 has 0, leftover-join.v10 of G19 has 0, leftover-join.v6 of anti-lockstep has 0, leftover-join.v9 of platform-tcb has 0. Every one of those was accepted and recorded. Self-voiced disclaimers are plentiful in the same files (38 in leftover-join.v20 of G21, 31 in leftover-join.v10 of G19, 30 in leftover-join.v16 of G20 and in leftover-join.v6 of anti-lockstep, 23 in leftover-join.v10 of G30). The corpus carries predecessor tokens freely and predecessor-voiced disclaimers not at all. The subject carries fourteen.

(4) The consequence is load-bearing because in these rows the disclaimer is the only place the constraint appears at obligation level. OBL-PREVIEW-NOT-ADVERTISED, OBL-G17, OBL-FC-APPLIC, OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM, OBL-FC-OUTFAIL, OBL-INACTIVE-DR006, OBL-G26 and OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY each end by disclaiming SARIF advertisement, G17 resurrection, D9 minting, RunId/Finding recipes, G26 theft from DR-131 or advisory discharge. If sarif leftover-join.v8 is recorded as the DR-122 leftover remasurement, those recorded row-level reasons assert the standing of the superseded version, and any reason lifted out of the file for a later decision record carries the wrong version's standing.
findings.notCuredBy: The deixis attack is separately clean — there is no "This leftover-join", "This join" or "This v8" anywhere in the subject — and the lineage-stemming attack is clean too. This is the adjacent defect the deixis rule exists to prevent, reached by an explicit predecessor name rather than by a deictic. sarif leftover-join.v7's dual ACCEPT 0/0 does not cure it either: under v7 these sentences were correct first-person, and the defect is created by the transformation into v8, not inherited as a flaw.
findings.repairShape: In a successor, re-voice all fourteen sentences to sarif leftover-join.v8, matching the pattern already present in OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX and OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX, and re-point findingDisposition.v6Speaker to the speaker it now describes. Where a statement about the predecessor is genuinely wanted, write it as history with an explicit marker, as obligations[5] already does. Wording only: no new digest, no new identifier, no edit to sarif leftover-join.v7, v6, v5 or v4, to either golden, to any occupancy, to file 08 or to COORD; it does not open Class A, close leftover-design, or SATISFY DR-122, DR-117, DR-131 or DR-133.

findings.title: basedOn.predecessorV4.role records sarif leftover-join.v4 as current — the dispatch's named attack — contradicting D-325, D-344, the subject's own authorityClaim, its own basedOn.predecessorV7.role, and its own doesNot list.
location: basedOn.predecessorV4.role — "sarif leftover-join.v4 remains current until a recordable successor is adopted."
findings.subjectClaim: The sentence is present-tense and unqualified: v4 remains current, and will remain current until some future successor is adopted. Nothing in the role demotes it; the role carries no "not current after D-325" clause.
findings.liveState: COORD D-325 (`a1d59af9fd51abe3494f177381af4c08a26fd153`), Decision: "Record sarif leftover-join.v7 as DR-122 leftover remasurement after D-324 … Frozen sarif leftover-join.v4 stays frozen; do not record it as current after this successor is recorded." That successor was recorded. COORD D-344, Decision, repeats it live at the last heading: "Frozen sarif leftover-join.v4 stays frozen; do not record it as current." The recordable successor the sentence waits for was adopted nineteen headings ago.
findings.refutation:
The sentence is false against live COORD and is contradicted three times inside the subject itself. authorityClaim: "Frozen sarif leftover-join.v4 is historical after D-325." basedOn.predecessorV7.role: "Current recorded DR-122 leftover remasurement is sarif leftover-join.v7 until a recordable successor is adopted." doesNot: "Does not record sarif leftover-join.v4 as current." A reader who opens basedOn.predecessorV4 is told v4 is current; a reader who opens basedOn.predecessorV7 is told v7 is current; both sentences use the identical trailing formula "until a recordable successor is adopted", so the document presents two artifacts as the same singular current recorded remasurement on the same clause. This is not redundancy — it is a currency claim, and the dispatch names "leftover-join.v4 of sarif recorded as current" as an attack the candidate must defeat. It defeats it in doesNot and loses it in basedOn.

The sentence was correct in sarif leftover-join.v5, v6 and v7, where v4 genuinely was the D-182 current recording and no successor had been adopted; it is byte-identical across all four documents. D-325 is precisely the event that falsified it, and it is the one clause of predecessorV4.role that the v8 authoring pass had to change and did not. The corpus shows the exact repair already in use: leftover-join.v10 of G19 writes its demoted predecessor as "Recorded as current G19 leftover-join at D-194; not current after D-256."
findings.notCuredBy: authorityClaim's "historical after D-325" does not cure it. The obligations and roles are the lift-out units of this document — that is the ground on which the v6 MF-1 class was adjudicated — and a recorded artifact cannot carry a live currency claim for a superseded version in a basedOn role on the strength of a correction elsewhere in the file. The doesNot entry does not cure it either: doesNot states what the artifact refrains from doing, and basedOn.predecessorV4.role does the thing.
findings.repairShape: Replace the sentence with an explicit demotion, e.g. "Recorded at D-182 as the then-current DR-122 leftover remasurement; not current after D-325." Wording only: no digest, no identifier, no edit to sarif leftover-join.v4 or any frozen artifact, file 08 or COORD.

findings.title: basedOn.predecessorV5.role rewrites the frozen sarif leftover-join.v5 Findings landing off sarif leftover-join.v7 onto the rejected, unrecorded sarif leftover-join.v6 — the dispatch's named attack — contradicting live D-344 and the subject's own authorityClaim and purpose.
location: basedOn.predecessorV5.role — "Frozen sarif leftover-join.v5 Stage A Claude REJECT MF-1 SF-1 SF-2; Codex ACCEPT 0/0. Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v6."
findings.subjectClaim: The role states the landing point for the frozen v5 findings is sarif leftover-join.v6.
findings.liveState: COORD D-344, the live last heading, states verbatim: "Frozen sarif leftover-join.v5 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7. Frozen sarif leftover-join.v6 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7." The dispatch freezes the same pair and adds "Do not rewrite those landings." sarif leftover-join.v6 is frozen, REJECTED by both reviewers and unrecorded; D-325 and D-344 both state it is not to be recorded as current.
findings.refutation:
The subject asserts both landings at once. authorityClaim: "Frozen sarif leftover-join.v5 Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7." purpose: the same sentence again. basedOn.predecessorV5.role: "Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v6." Two of the three cannot be true, and the two that agree with live D-344 are the two the role contradicts. A reader cannot determine from this document where the frozen v5 findings land.

The asymmetry inside basedOn settles that this is an unconverted residue rather than deliberate history. basedOn.predecessorV6.role, immediately above it, reads "Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7 as one class" — correct, and matching D-325 and D-344. Both roles are byte-identical to sarif leftover-join.v7, where both were correct at the time. D-344 re-froze the v5 landing onto v7; the v6 role happened to survive that re-freeze unchanged and the v5 role did not, and the authoring pass converted neither. The subject picked up the re-frozen sentence in authorityClaim and purpose and left the role stating the superseded value.

The consequence is not cosmetic. It parks the landing of three adjudicated findings — v5 Stage A Claude MF-1, SF-1 and SF-2 — on an artifact that is frozen, rejected and unrecorded, and that both D-325 and D-344 forbid recording as current. If sarif leftover-join.v8 is recorded, the recorded custody chain for those three findings points at the one link in it that was never recorded.
findings.notCuredBy: The historical fact that sarif leftover-join.v6 was the document that first landed those three findings does not cure it: D-344 is live, it is the last heading, it states the landing at v7, the dispatch forbids rewriting it, and the subject itself affirms v7 twice. Nor does it cure the internal contradiction, which stands on the subject's own bytes independently of which value is correct.
findings.repairShape: Write "Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7" in basedOn.predecessorV5.role, matching basedOn.predecessorV6.role, the subject's own authorityClaim and purpose, and live D-344. Wording only: no digest, no identifier, no edit to sarif leftover-join.v5 or v6, file 08 or COORD.

decision.rule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX.
decision.reason: The measurement work is sound and the custody discipline is exact: 98 recomputed digests with zero mismatches, HEAD triple-matched, eight cited commits resolved, last-heading custody clean at D-344, and the substantive remasurement independently confirmed in bytes — fixtures/sarif-fc-nonauth-term.v2/ holds exactly the eight per-D-002-platform copies on the ORDERED-EQUAL G10/G23 platform list, each byte-identical to its D-296 original, which is what makes reducing leftoverDesign to [OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX] correct rather than merely asserted. Nineteen of the twenty-two dispatch attacks are defeated on the bytes. The candidate fails on the conversion pass from its predecessor. Fourteen present-tense disclaimers across nine of the eleven obligations and five basedOn roles still name sarif leftover-join.v7 as the actor, reinstating the exact finding class that rejected sarif leftover-join.v6 and that sarif leftover-join.v7 was recorded for closing; zero such sentences appear in any of the seven sibling joins accepted and recorded on this branch. Two further inherited sentences are now false against live COORD and against the subject's own text: basedOn.predecessorV4.role still records sarif leftover-join.v4 as current after D-325 and D-344 both wrote "do not record it as current", and basedOn.predecessorV5.role still lands the frozen v5 findings on the rejected, unrecorded sarif leftover-join.v6 where live D-344 lands them at sarif leftover-join.v7. Both are named attacks in the dispatch, and both are defeated in the doesNot list while being committed in basedOn.
decision.consequenceIfRecordedAsIs: The recorded DR-122 leftover remasurement would carry eight obligation rows whose only disclaimer of SARIF advertisement, G17 resurrection, D9 minting, RunId/Finding recipes, G26 theft from DR-131 and advisory discharge is attached to the superseded version rather than the recorded one; a live currency claim for sarif leftover-join.v4 nineteen headings after D-325 demoted it, contradicting the same document's authorityClaim and doesNot; and a custody chain that lands three adjudicated findings on an artifact that was rejected by both reviewers and never recorded. Any role or reason lifted out of the file for a later decision record would carry the wrong version's standing.
decision.pathToAccept: In a successor: re-voice the fourteen disclaimers to sarif leftover-join.v8 and re-point findingDisposition.v6Speaker (MF-1); demote basedOn.predecessorV4.role with an explicit "not current after D-325" (MF-2); write "Findings land at sarif leftover-join.v7" in basedOn.predecessorV5.role (MF-3). All three are wording-only. Nothing else in the candidate needs to change: no digest, no identifier, no edit to any frozen artifact, fixture, file 08 or COORD, no remasurement of sarif-fc-nonauth-term-golden.v4, occupancy v2 of G26 or leftover-join.v7 of G29, and no opening of Class A, closing of leftover-design of OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX, or SATISFY of DR-122, DR-117, DR-131 or DR-133.
